Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand checkouts collect payment and shipping information in accordance with their own privacy policies; card information never reaches Marracat. By checking multiple brands at once, your name, email, phone number, and address from this phone will be sent directly to each brand. Once payment is completed, Marracat stores the label, products, date, quantities, displayed subtotal, and when Shopify delivers them, the order reference, total amount, and currency – never card details or delivery addresses. If the Marracat email for your account is enabled, the labels will receive a private address u-…@orders.marracat.com instead of your email. Their emails will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will store the order and tracking number from them (tracking numbers are sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). If you delete your account, the address and any received information will also be deleted. After logging out, labels can get a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order information, updates your orders, notifies this iPhone, and stores each email for up to three days if you log in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other account still receives the order's emails), and an account that doesn't receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For checkout, the Marracat server also builds the checkout and order number (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account) and reads the brand’s order number page for progress and tracking information until delivery or 30 days. On this iPhone, recommendations, search for meaning, styles, reminders for restocking, and your written interests are calculated; what you browse, search, and write about them remains here, and personalized recommendations are turned off. You can find them through Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, products you've recently viewed are added to iPhone's own search index along with Marracat's featured brands. This index remains on iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and when you log out or delete your account, your items are removed from it. Widgets on the home screen and lock screen read a small copy of the app, which is stored on this iPhone, in a storage space shared only with its own widgets: price discounts on your saved items, Marracat's selected brands, and delivery status of your recent orders, as well as small product images. Nothing sent to Marracat, and when you log out or delete your account, it is deleted. Products added to a cart or purchased together will be shipped with this installation's random key, so Marracat can display pairs that at least three installations have made. Hold messages are stored in your account: When an item is returned, Marracat sends an email to your account address and notifies all iPhones logged in to it, and when you log out, notifications on iPhone stop. To send live activities to today's deliveries, you need to send Marracat the tokens that Apple issues to those linked to the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple each order's label, item, status, and carrier to display. Turn them off under "You" › Notifications. By marking an order as "Late Shipment", the label and a one-way hash of the order associated with the same key are sent so that Marracat can see which labels are sending late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: The payment and shipping information is collected by the brand checkouts in accordance with their own data protection regulations; the card data never reaches Marracat. If you view multiple brands at the same time, your name, email address, phone number and address will be sent directly from this phone to each brand. When a checkout is completed, Marracat stores the brand, the products, the date, the quantities, the displayed subtotal, and, if Shopify provides it, the order reference, the total amount and the currency - never the card data or delivery addresses. If the Marracat order email for your account is activated, the brands will receive a private u-…@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; their emails will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will store the order number and their shipping tracking information (tracking numbers are sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account will delete the address and everything it has received. When unsubscribing, brands can receive a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox list to which you can forward, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, notifies iPhone of this, and keeps each email for no more than three days if you log in; logging in on this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other still receives the emails of this order), and one that receives nothing for 180 days is deleted. For checkouts, Marracat's server also stores the checkout and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account) and reads the brand's order status page for progress and tracking, until delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, search for meaning, styles, filling-in notifications and your written interests are developed on this iPhone; what you search, look for and write for them remains here, and personalized recommendations disable them. You can therefore add them to your own search index from iPhone through Spotlight and Siri, your saved articles, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations on the products you have recently viewed, together with the brands presented by Marracat; this index remains on this iPhone, nothing of it is sent to Marracat, and unsubscribing or deleting your account removes your articles from it. The widgets on the home screen and lock screen read a small copy of the app that they store on this iPhone in a storage that is only shared with their own widgets: discounts on your saved items, the brands presented on Marracat and the delivery status of your last orders with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and unsubscribing or deleting your account will delete it. Products that are added to a shopping cart or purchased together are sent with the random key of this installation so that Marracat pairs can display those who have made at least three installations. Reorder alerts are stored in your account: When an item returns, Marracat sends the address of your account by e-mail and notifies all iPhones who have logged in to it, and logging out stops the notifications on this iPhone. For today's deliveries, send Marracat the tokens Apple, which are issued by them and are bound to the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple the brand, item, status and carrier of each order that should be displayed; turn them off under "You" › Notifications. If an order is marked as "shipping delayed", the brand and a one-sided hash of this order, which is linked to the same key, will be sent so that Marracat can see which brands are shipping late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Payments and shipping details are collected in the payments of the brands under their own privacy policies; the card details never reach Marracat. Buy several brands at once send your name, email, phone and address from this phone directly to each brand. When the payment is completed, Marracat stores the brand, the products, the date, the quantities, the subtotal shown and, when Shopify provides them, the order reference, the total and the currency, never the card details or the shipping addresses. Where the Marracat order email is enabled for your account, the brands receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; your emails are forwarded to you and Marracat keeps the order number and tracking information for you (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account will delete the address and what you received. After logging out, the brands can obtain a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash), not an account: there is no inbox to send back to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates Your Orders, notifies this iPhone and keeps each email for a maximum of three days in case it logs in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other still receives the emails from that order), and one that does not receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For payments, the application builds, the Marracat server also maintains the payment and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not to your account) and reads the brand's order status page for progress and tracking, until delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, searches by meaning, styles, inventory replenishment reminders and their written interests are processed in this iPhone; what you browse, search and write for them stays here, and personalized recommendations are disabled. So you can find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, the products you have seen recently are added to the search index of this iPhone itself, along with the highlighted brands of Marracat; that index is maintained in this iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account removes your items from it. The widgets on the home screen and the lock screen read a small copy of the application that is kept in this iPhone, in the shared storage only with your own widgets: price drops on your saved items, the highlights of Marracat and the delivery status of your recent orders, with small product photos. Nothing in what it contains is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account will erase it. Products added to a cart or purchased together are shipped with the random key of this installation so that Marracat can show pairs that at least three installations have made. Replenishment alerts are kept with your account: when an item becomes available again, Marracat sends an email to the address of your account and notifies each iPhone that has logged in to it, and closing the session stops notifications on that iPhone. Live activities for today's deliveries, send Marracat the Apple tokens that it issues for them, linked to the same installation key, and Marracat send Apple the brand, the item, the status and the carrier of each order to display; deactivate them in Notice › Notifications. Mark an order as "Late shipment" sends the brand and an outbound hash of that order, linked to the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands ship late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Payments and shipping information are collected during brand checks in accordance with their own privacy policies; card details are never transmitted to Marracat. By consulting several brands at the same time, your name, your email address, your telephone number and your address come from this telephone and are sent directly to each brand. When payment is completed, Marracat stores the brand, products, date, quantities, displayed subtotal and, when Shopify provides them, the order reference, total and currency - never the card details or shipping addresses. When the Marracat order email is activated for your account, the brands receive a private address u-...@orders.marracat.com instead of your email; their emails are sent to you, and Marracat keeps the order number and tracking reading (tracking numbers are sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). The deletion of your account will delete the address and what it has received. Disconnected, the brands can obtain a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to send back, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, sends a notification to this iPhone and keeps each email for up to three days in case you log in; you log in on this iPhone moves the address and what it has received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other always receives the emails of this order), and the one that does not receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For payments, the application builds, the Marracat server also keeps the reference of the payment and the order (linked to a random key for this installation, and not to your account) and reads the order status page of the brand to follow the progress and tracking, until delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, search by meaning, styles, replenishment reminders and your written interests are processed on this iPhone; what you consult, search and write for them remains here, and personalized recommendations disable them. You can therefore find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved articles, the brands you follow and, with the personalized recommendations, the products you have consulted recently are added to the search index of this iPhone, as well as the featured brands of Marracat; this index remains on this iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and the disconnection or deletion of your account removes your articles from it. The widgets on the home screen and the lock screen read a small copy that the application keeps on this iPhone, in the shared storage only with its own widgets: price drops on your registered items, featured brands from Marracat and the delivery status of your recent orders, with small product photos. None of this content is sent to Marracat, and disconnecting or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to a basket or purchased together are sent with the random key of this installation so that Marracat can display the pairs that at least three installations have made. Replenishment alerts are stored in your account: when the item is back in stock, Marracat sends the address of your account by email and informs each iPhone connected to it, and the disconnection stops notifications on this iPhone. The live activities for today's deliveries send Marracat the Apple tokens issued for them, linked to the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple the brand, the item, the condition and the carrier of each order to display; turn them off under You › Notifications. Marking an order as "Late shipment" sends the brand and a simple hash of this order, linked to the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands ship late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Payments made through the checkout of the brands collect payment and shipping details according to their own privacy policies; the card details never reach Marracat. To consult several brands simultaneously, send your name, email address, phone number and address from this phone directly to each brand. When the payment is completed, Marracat stores the brand, products, date, quantities, displayed subtotal and, when Shopify provides them, the order reference, total and currency, never the card details or shipping addresses. Where the Marracat order email is active for your account, the brands receive a private address u-...@orders.marracat.com instead of your email; their emails are forwarded to you and Marracat keeps the order number and tracking information read by them (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). The cancellation of your account will delete the address and what you have received. Session ended, the brands can obtain a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, notifies this iPhone and keeps every email for a maximum of three days in case you access it; accessing this iPhone moves the address and what it received on your account (an account that has an address keeps it and the other still receives emails from that order), and one that doesn't receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For payments, the app builds, the Marracat server also keeps the reference to the payment and order (linked to a random key for this installation, not to your account) and reads the brand's order status page for progress and tracking, up to delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, search by meaning, styles, refill reminders and your written interests are processed on this iPhone; what you search for, search for and write for them remains here, and personalized recommendations turn them off. So you can find them from Spotlight and Siri, from saved articles, from the brands you follow and, with the personalized tips on, the products you have recently viewed are added to the search index of this iPhone, together with the featured brands of Marracat; that index remains on this iPhone, nothing of it is sent to Marracat and the disconnection or deletion of your account removes the articles from it. The widgets on the home screen and the lock screen read a small copy of the app that is stored on this iPhone, in the shared storage system only with your widgets: discounts on your saved items, Marracat's featured brands and the delivery status of your recent orders, with small photos of the products. Nothing contained in it is sent to Marracat, and the disconnection or deletion of your account will delete it. Products added to a cart or purchased together are sent with the random key of this installation so that Marracat can show the pairs that at least three installations have made. Supply alerts are stored in your account: when an item returns, Marracat sends an email to the address of your account and notifies every iPhone that has connected to it, and disconnection stops notifications on that iPhone. Live activity for today's deliveries send Marracat the Apple tokens issued for them, linked to the same installation key, and Marracat send Apple the brand, the item, the status and the carrier of each order to be shown; disable them in Settings › Notifications. Marking an order as "Delayed shipment" sends the brand and a one-way hash of that order, linked to the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands are delayed.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand checkout collects payment and shipping details based on its own privacy policy. Card details never reach Marracat. If you check multiple brands at once, your name, email address, phone number, and address will be sent directly to each brand from this mobile phone. When checkout is completed, Marracat saves the brand, product, date, quantity, displayed subtotal, and if Shopify is provided, the order reference, total, and currency. Card details and shipping address are not saved. If the Marracat order email is enabled in your account, the brand will receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com address, not your email address. Their email will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will keep track of the order number and tracking information (the tracking number will be sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). If you delete your account, your address and the contents you received will also be deleted. When you sign out, the brand can obtain a private address linked to a random key associated with this installation (Marracat only stores its one-way hash). There is nothing to be forwarded to the inbox instead of the account. Therefore, Marracat reads the same order details, updates the order, notifies this iPhone, and retains each email for up to 3 days if you sign in. If you sign in with this iPhone, the address and what you received will move to the account (an account with an address will keep it, and the other account will continue to receive emails for that order). If you don't receive anything for 180 days, it will be deleted. For checkout, the Marracat server built by the app keeps checkout and order references (which are associated with a random key in this installation and are not related to the account) and loads the brand's order status page for tracking delivery or progress within 30 days. In this iPhone, searches are made based on recommendations, meaning, style, restock reminders, and your written interests. What you browse, search, and write for them is left here, and personalized recommendations turn them off. Therefore, you can find them from Spotlight, Siri, saved items, and brands you follow. In addition, personalized recommendations for items you have recently viewed are displayed and added to this iPhone-specific search index. This index is saved on this iPhone and its contents are not sent to Marracat, and if you log out or delete your account, the items in it will be deleted. The widgets on the home screen and lock screen read a small copy of the app stored on this iPhone and are saved in the shared storage with your own widgets. Saved items, featured brands from Marracat, delivery status of recent orders, and price drops of small product photos will be displayed. Nothing in it will be sent to Marracat, and it will be deleted if you log out or delete your account. Products added to the cart or purchased together will be sent with this random installation key, so Marracat can indicate that a pair has been created at least 3 times during installation. Restock alerts are saved in your account. When the product is restocked, Marracat will send an email to the address in your account, and iPhone, who signed in to it, will be notified, and when you sign out, the notification will be stopped at iPhone. In today's delivery live activity, Apple sends the tokens issued by Apple to Marracat associated with the same installation key, and Marracat sends the brand, item, status, and carrier information of each order to Apple to display. These can be turned off in "User" › "Notifications". If you mark an order as "delayed shipment", the one-way hash of that order associated with the same key as the brand will be sent. This allows Marracat to determine which brand is delaying shipments.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: When paying through the branded payment system, they collect payment and shipping information in accordance with their own privacy policy; card information never reaches Marracat. By checking out multiple brands at once, your name, email address, phone number, and address from this phone will be sent directly to each brand. When a box is completed, Marracat stores brand, products, date, quantities, subtotal display, and, when Shopify provides them, order reference, total, and currency—never card details or delivery addresses. If Marracat order email is enabled for your account, brands will receive a private email address at u-…@orders.marracat.com instead of your email address. Their emails will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will store the order number and tracking information from them (tracking numbers are sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). If you delete your account, the address and any received information will also be deleted. After you log out, brands can get a private address associated with a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, notifies this iPhone, and retains each email for a maximum of three days in case you log in; if you log in to this iPhone, the address and content it received are moved to your account (an account that has an address retains it, and the other still receives emails from that order), and one that doesn't receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For checkout, the Marracat server also stores the checkout number and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account), and reads the brand’s order status page for progress and tracking information, up to 30 days before delivery. Recommendations, search for meaning, styles, restocking reminders, and your written interests are processed on this iPhone; what you browse, search for, and write about remains here, and personal recommendations are turned off. You can find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, products you've recently viewed are added to iPhone's own search index, along with Marracat's selected brands. This index remains on iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and when you log out or delete your account, your items are removed from it. Widgets on the home screen and lock screen read a small copy that the app stores on this iPhone, in the storage space shared only with its own widgets: price reductions on stored items, Marracat's selected brands, and delivery status of your recent orders, as well as small product images. Nothing sent to Marracat, and it is deleted by logging out or deleting your account. Products added to the cart or purchased together are sent with this installation's random key, allowing Marracat to display pairs that at least three installations have created. Restocking notifications are stored in your account: When an item is back in stock, Marracat sends an email to the address on your account and notifies all iPhones logged in to it. When you log out, the notifications stop on iPhone. To show live activity for today's deliveries, send the Marracat tokens Apple sends for them, which are linked to the same installation key, and Marracat sends the Apple label, item, status, and carrier for each order. Turn them off under "You" › Confirmations. By marking an order as "late shipment," the brand and a one-way hash of the order, linked to the same key, are sent so that Marracat can see which brands are sending late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand payments collect payment and shipping information under their own privacy policy; card information never reaches Marracat. Viewing multiple brands at once sends your name, email, phone and address from this phone directly to each brand. When a payment is completed, Marracat stores the brand, the products, the date, the quantities, the displayed subtotal and, when Shopify provides them, the order reference, the total and the currency - never card details or shipping addresses. Where the Marracat order email is enabled for your account, brands receive a private address u-...@orders.marracat.com instead of your email; their emails are forwarded to you and Marracat keeps track of their order number and tracking information (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Removing your account will delete the address information and what it has received. When logging out, brands can get a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, reports this to iPhone and keeps every email for up to three days in case you log in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it has received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other still receives the emails of that order), and one that receives nothing for 180 days is deleted. Before completing the payment, the app also keeps track of the payment and order reference (connected to a random key for this installation, not your account) from Marracat's server and reads the brand's order status page for progress and tracking, until delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, searches by meaning, styles, replenishment reminders and your written interests are calculated on this iPhone; what you look at, search for and write remains here, and personalized recommendations are turned off. So you can find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow and, with personalized recommendations, products you have recently viewed are added to the own search index of this iPhone, together with the brands presented by Marracat; that index remains on this iPhone, nothing of it is sent to Marracat, and closing your session or deleting your account removes your items from it. Widgets on the home screen and the lock screen read a small copy that the app stores on this iPhone, in storage that is only shared with its own widgets: price drops on your saved items, the brands presented by Marracat and the delivery status of your recent orders, with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and closing your session or deleting your account will erase it. Products that have been added to a shopping cart or purchased together are shipped with the random key of this installation, so that Marracat can show pairs that have made at least three installations. Restock notifications are kept track of with your account: when an item is back in stock, Marracat sends the address details of your account and notifies every iPhone that has logged in to it, and closing the session stops the notifications on that iPhone. Live activities for today's deliveries send Marracat the tokens Apple they have outstanding, linked to the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple the brand, item, status and carrier of each order to display; turn them off under U › Notifications. Marking an order as "Sent too late" sends the brand and a one-way hash of that order, linked to the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands are sending too late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: The brand's cash registers collect payment and shipping details according to their own privacy policy; card details never reach Marracat. Checking several brands at the same time sends your name, email address, phone number and address from that phone directly to each brand. After the checkout ends, Marracat stores the brand, products, date, quantities, the displayed partial sum, and when Shopify provides it, the order reference number, the amount and currency - never the card details or shipping addresses. Where the Marracat order email is on your account, brands receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com instead of your email; their emails are forwarded to you, and Marracat stores the order number and tracking read from them (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting the account deletes the address and the received. Signed Out, Brands can receive a private address associated with a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way shortcut), not an account: There is no inbox to pass on, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your orders, notifies this iPhone, and stores each email for a maximum of three days if you log in; logging in on this iPhone transfers the address and what it received to your account (the account that has the address stores it, and the other still receives the emails of that order), and the one that does not receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For cash registers that the application builds, the Marracat server also stores the cash register and order reference (tied to a random key for this installation, not your account) and reads the brand order status page for progress and tracking, until the delivery time or 30 days. Recommendations, search by meaning, styles, replenishment reminders, and your written interests are worked out on this iPhone; what you browse, search, and write for them stays here, and personalized recommendations turn them off. So you can find them from Spotlight and Siri, saved items, brands you follow, and along with personalized recommendations, products you've recently viewed are added to your own search index of that iPhone, along with recommended brands Marracat; this index stays on that iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting an account removes items from it. The home screen and lock screen widgets read a small copy that the app stores in this iPhone, in a warehouse shared only with its own widgets: price drops for saved items, recommended Marracat brands, and delivery status of recent orders, with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting an account deletes it. Products added to the cart or bought together are sent using the random key of this installation, so that Marracat can show pairs made by at least three installations. Recharge alerts are stored in your account: when the item returns, Marracat emails your account address and notifies each iPhone logged in to it, and logging out stops notifications on that iPhone. Live activities for today's deliveries send Marracat tokens Apple spends for them, tied to the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple the brand, position, status and carrier of each order to display; disable them under You › Notifications. The order marking "Delayed shipping" sends the brand and the one-way shortcut of this order, associated with the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands are sending late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand checkouts collect payment and shipping details under their own privacy policies; card details never reach Marracat. Check several brands at the same time send your name, email, phone number and address of this phone directly to each brand. When checkout is completed, Marracat stores the brand, products, date, quantities, displayed subtotal, and when Shopify provides them, the order reference, total and currency - never the card details or shipping addresses. Where the Marracat order email is activated for your account, the brands receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; your emails are forwarded to you, and Marracat keeps the order number and their read tracking information (the tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account deletes the address and what it received. Disconnected, the brands can obtain a private address linked to a random key for this installation (the Marracat stores only a forward hash), not an account: there is no inbox to forward, so the Marracat reads the same order details, updates its orders, notifies this iPhone and keeps each email for a maximum of three days if you log in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other still receives the emails from this order), and one that does not receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For payments, the built-in application, the Marracat server also keeps the payment and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not to your account) and reads the brand's order status page for progress and tracking, until delivery or 30 days. Recommendations, search by meaning, styles, stock replenishment reminders and your written interests are processed in this iPhone; what you browse, search and write for them remains here, and the personalized recommendations turn them off. So you can find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, the products you have viewed recently are added to the search index of this iPhone itself, along with the featured brands of Marracat; this index remains in this iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account removes your items from it. The home screen and lock screen widgets read a small copy that the app keeps on this iPhone, in the shared storage only with its own widgets: price drops on its saved items, highlights from Marracat and the delivery status of its recent orders, with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account deletes it. Products added to a cart or purchased together are sent with the random key of this installation so that Marracat can show pairs that at least three installations have made. Replenishment alerts are kept with your account: when an item is back, Marracat sends an email to your account address and notifies each iPhone that is connected to it, and exiting the system stops notifications on that iPhone. Live activities for today's deliveries send Marracat the Apple tokens issued to them, linked to the same installation key and Marracat send Apple the brand, the item, the status and the carrier of each order to show; turn them off in You › Notifications. Marking an order as "Delayed shipment" sends the brand and an outgoing hash of that order, linked to the same key, so that Marracat can see which brands are sending late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand checkouts collect payment and shipping details under their own privacy policies; card details never reach Marracat. Checking multiple brands at once sends your name, email, phone number, and address from this phone directly to each brand. When checkout is completed, Marracat stores the brand, products, date, quantities, displayed subtotal, and when Shopify provides them, order reference, total, and currency—never card details or shipping addresses. Where Marracat order email is enabled for your account, brands receive a private u-…@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; your emails are forwarded to you and Marracat keeps their read order number and tracking (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account will delete the address and what it received. Offline, the brands can obtain a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates Your Orders, notifies this iPhone, and keeps each email for a maximum of three days if you log in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address keeps it, and the other still receives the emails from that order), and one that doesn't receive anything for 180 days is deleted. For payments, the Marracat server also keeps the payment and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account) and reads the brand's order status page to track progress and tracking, up to delivery or 30 days. The recommendations, search by meaning, styles, refill reminders, and your written interests are processed in this iPhone; what you browse, search, and write for them stays here, and the personalized recommendations turn them off. So, you can find them in the Spotlight and Siri, in your saved items, in the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, the products you have recently viewed are added to the search index of this iPhone itself, along with the featured brands from Marracat; that index remains in this iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account removes your items from it. The home screen and lock screen widgets read a small copy that the app keeps on this iPhone, in the shared storage only with your own widgets: price drops on your saved items, the featured brands on Marracat, and the delivery status of your recent orders, with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting the account will delete it. Products added to a cart or purchased together are shipped with this installation's random key so that Marracat can show pairs that at least three installations have made. Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Payment and delivery details are collected by the brand cashier in accordance with their own privacy policies; card details never reach Marracat. If you are browsing multiple brands at the same time, your name, email address, phone number, and address from this phone will be sent directly to each brand. When a payment is complete, Marracat stores brand, product, date, quantity, displayed subtotal, and, when Shopify provides them, order reference, total amount, and currency – never card details or delivery addresses. If Marracat order email is enabled for your account, brands will receive a private email address u-…@orders.marracat.com instead of your email address. Their emails will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will retain the order number and tracking information from them (tracking numbers are sent to 17TRACK for delivery updates). If you delete your account, the address and everything sent to it will be deleted. After logging out, brands can get a private address linked to a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates Your orders, notifies this iPhone, and retains each email for up to three days if you log in; logging in to this iPhone moves the address and what it received to your account (an account that has an address retains it, and the other still receives the order's email messages), and one that doesn't receive anything for 180 days is removed. To handle payments, Marracat's server also stores payment and order references (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account) and checks the brand's order status website to track progress and track the order until delivery or 30 days later. Recommendations, search for meaning, style, reminders of stock updates, and your written interests are calculated on this iPhone; everything you browse, search, and write for them is here, and personalized recommendations turn them off. That's why you can find them in Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and with personalized recommendations, products you've recently viewed are added to iPhone's own search index, along with Marracat's selected brands; that index remains on iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and if you log out or delete your account, your items are removed from it. Widgets on the home screen and lock screen read a small copy that the app stores on this iPhone, in a storage space shared only with its own widgets: price drops for your saved items, Marracat's selected brands, and delivery status for your recent orders, along with small product photos. Nothing in that state is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to the cart or purchased together are shipped with the random key for this installation, so that Marracat can show pairs that at least three installations have made. Inventory replenishment reminders are stored in your account: When an item is back in stock, Marracat sends an email to the address on your account and notifies all iPhones logged in to it. Logging out stops the messages on iPhone. To receive information about today's deliveries, send Marracat to Apple, which will send the tokens linked to the same installation key, and Marracat will send Apple with the brand, item, status, and carrier for each order. To turn this off, go to "You" > "Messages". If you mark an order as "late delivery", the brand and a one-way hash of that order, which is linked to the same key, will be sent so that Marracat can see which brands are delivering late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand payment points collect payment and shipping details within their own privacy policies; card details never reach Marracat. To review multiple brands at once, it sends your name, email, phone number and address directly to each brand from this phone. When a payment is completed, T0 stores the T0 brand, products, date, quantities, subtotal displayed and the order reference, total and currency when T1 provides them - never card details or shipping addresses. While the Marracat order email is open in your account, the brands receive a special u-...@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; the emails are sent to you and read the Marracat order number and tracking information from them (tracking numbers go to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account also deletes your address and what you received. When you log out, the brands may not own an account, but rather a special address associated with a random key for this installation (Marracat only stores its one-way password), there is no incoming mailbox to send to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your Orders, reports this iPhone, and if you log in, it keeps each email for up to three days; logging in to this iPhone transfers the address and what it receives to your account (an account with an address stores it and the other still receives the emails of that order), and an account that does not receive anything for 180 days is deleted. The application created for payment also stores the server of Marracat's payment and order reference (connected with a random key for this installation, not with your account) and reads the brand's order status page for delivery or progress and tracking up to 30 days in advance. Suggestions, meaning, style, stock calendar reminders and your written interests are calculated in this iPhone; everything you scan, search and write for these stays here and Personalized suggestions close them. Therefore, they are added to iPhone's own search index together with the featured brands of Marracat, along with personalized recommendations with Spotlight and Siri, your recorded items, the brands you follow and the products you have recently viewed; this index remains in this iPhone, nothing is sent to Marracat from it, and closing or deleting your account allows your items to be removed from the index. The Home Screen and Lock Screen components read a small copy that the application keeps in this iPhone in the warehouse shared only with its own components: price drops in your saved items, the featured brands of Marracat and the delivery status of your last orders, along with small product photos. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat and closing or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to a cart or purchased together are sent with this setup's random key, so Marracat can show pairs made by at least three setups. Renewal alerts are kept with your account: when a product returns, Marracat sends the address of your account and sends a notification to every iPhone that logs in to it, and logs out stops the notifications on that iPhone. For today's deliveries, live events send the tokens given to them by Apple, which is connected with the same installation key, to Marracat, and Marracat sends Apple to show the brand, item, status and carrier of each order; close them under You › Notifications. Marking an order as "Delayed delivery" sends the brand and a one-way password for that order linked to the same key, so Marracat can see which brands are making delayed deliveries.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: Brand stores collect payment and shipping information according to their own privacy policy; card information is never sent to Marracat. Checking several brands at once will send your name, email, phone number, and address directly from this phone to each brand. When the payment is completed, Marracat stores the brand, product, date, quantity, total amount displayed, and, when Shopify provides them, the order reference, total amount, and currency type - never the card details or shipping address. The Marracat order email address is enabled for your account, and the brands receive a private address u-...@orders.marracat.com instead of your email; their email is forwarded to you, and Marracat retains the order number and tracking number read from them (tracking numbers are forwarded to 17TRACK for delivery updates). Deleting your account will delete the address and what it has received. After logging out, brands can receive a private address associated with a random key for this setting (Marracat only stores a one-way hash of it), not an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads back the same order details, updates your Order, notifies this iPhone, and keeps each email for up to three days in case you log in; logging in on this iPhone will transfer its received address and content to your account (an account with an address will keep it, and another account will still receive the email of that order), and an account that does not receive anything for 180 days will be deleted. For payment, the application is built, and the Marracat server also retains payment information and order reference (linked to a random key for this installation, not your account) and reads the brand's order status page to track progress and monitor, until delivery or 30 days. Suggestions, searches by meaning, style, additional inventory reminders, and your interests are calculated on this iPhone; what you browse, search, and write for them will be saved here, and Personalized Suggestions will turn them off. Therefore, you can find them from Spotlight and Siri, your saved items, the brands you follow, and, with Personalized Recommendations about, the products you have recently viewed are added to iPhone's private search index, along with Marracat's featured brands; that index will be retained on iPhone, nothing from it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account will remove your items from it. The Home Screen and Lock Screen utilities keep a small copy of the application on iPhone, in shared memory only with its own utilities: discounted prices on your saved items, Marracat's featured brands, and the delivery status of your recent orders, along with small product images. Nothing in it is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to the cart or purchased together are sent with a random key of this installation to allow Marracat to display pairs that at least three installations have performed. Additional stock alerts are stored in your account: when an item returns, Marracat will send an email to your account address and notify each iPhone logged in to it, and logging out will stop notifications on that iPhone. Directly activate for today's deliveries to send Marracat the Apple-issued codes, which are associated with the same installation key, and Marracat sends Apple the brand, item, status, and carrier of each order to display; turn them off under You › Notifications. Marking an order as "Late Delivery Order" will send the brand and a one-way hash of that order, linked to the same key, so Marracat can see which brands are late.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: The brand collects payment and shipping details under its own privacy policy at checkout; card details never reach Marracat. Viewing multiple brands at once sends the names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses you send from your phone directly to each brand. At checkout, Marracat stores the brand, product, date, quantity, subtotal displayed, and Shopify stores the order reference number, total amount, and currency when provided—never the card number or shipping address. If Marracat order email is enabled on your account, the brand will receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; their email will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will retain the order number and tracking information (the tracking number will be forwarded to 17TRACK for delivery update information). Deleting your account will delete the address and the content it received. After logging out, the brand can obtain a private address associated with a random key installed with this (Marracat only stores its one-way hash value), instead of an account: there is no mailbox to forward, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your order, notifies this iPhone, and retains each email for up to three days when you log in; logging in on this iPhone transfers the address and received content to your account (an account with an address will retain it, while another account will still receive the email of the order), and an account with no content for 180 days will be deleted. For the checkout of the built application, the server of Marracat will also retain the checkout and order reference (bound to the random key installed with this installation, not your account), and read the order status page of the brand to get progress and tracking information until delivery or 30 days. This iPhone calculates recommendations, searches by meaning, style, replenishment reminders and your written interests; what you browse, search and write for them will be kept here, and personalized recommendations will close them. Therefore, you can find them from Spotlight and Siri, the projects you save, the brands you follow, and the products you recently browsed with personalized recommendations will be added to this iPhone's own search index, as well as the featured brands of Marracat; the index is retained on this iPhone, and nothing is sent to Marracat. Logging out or deleting your account will remove your projects from the index. The Home screen and Lock screen widgets read a small copy of the apps that are saved on this iPhone, which shares storage space with its own widgets only: your saved items, featured brands on Marracat, the delivery status of your recent orders, price drops, and small product photos. No content will be sent to Marracat. Logging out or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to the cart or purchased together will be sent with the random key installed with this to allow Marracat to display at least three pairings made with the installation. Stock replenishment reminders are kept in your account: when the goods are re-stocked, Marracat will send an email to your account address and notify each iPhone who logs in to the account. Logout will stop the notifications on iPhone. For today's delivery, send T0 to them in real time to send the T1 tokens they sent. These tokens are bound to the same installation key. Send T2 to send the brand, goods, status and carrier of each order; close them under "You" > "Notifications". Marking an order as "Delayed Shipment" sends the brand and order's one-way hash value out, which is bound to the same key, so Marracat can see which brands have delayed shipments.

Brand checkouts collect payment and ship.back: The brand checkout collects payment and shipping details according to its own privacy policy; card details are never sent to Marracat. A one-time view of several brands will send your name, email, phone number and address directly from this phone to each brand. When the checkout is completed, Marracat stores the brand, product, date, quantity, subtotal displayed, and when Shopify is provided, the order reference, total amount and currency - never stores card details or delivery address. Where the Marracat order email is displayed on your account, the brand will receive a private u-...@orders.marracat.com address instead of your email; their email will be forwarded to you, and Marracat will retain the order number and the tracking information read from them (the tracking number will be forwarded to 17TRACK for delivery update information). Deleting your account will delete your address and the content you receive. After logging out, the brand can obtain a private address bound to a random key installed with this (Marracat only stores its one-way hash), instead of an account: there is no inbox to forward to, so Marracat reads the same order details, updates your order, notifies this iPhone and retains it for up to three days per email in case you log in; logging in here on iPhone will move the address and its received content to your account (an account with an address will retain it, while another account will still receive the email of the order), and accounts that have not received any emails within 180 days will be deleted. For the billing generated by the application build, the Marracat server also retains the billing and order reference (bound to the random key installed with this, not your account), and reads the brand's order status page to get progress and tracking until delivery or 30 days. This iPhone will search based on your suggestions, by meaning, style, restocking reminders and written interests; the content you browse, search and write for them will be retained here, and personalized suggestions will be turned off. Therefore, you can find them from Spotlight and Siri, the items you have saved, the brands you follow, and personalized recommendations for products you have recently viewed will be added to this iPhone's own search index, as well as the selected brands of Marracat; the index is retained here on iPhone, and its content will not be sent to Marracat. Logging out or deleting your account will remove your items from the index. The main screen and lock screen widgets read a small copy of the application saved on iPhone, which is only shared with its own widget in storage: the items you have saved, Marracat selected brands, the price drop of your recent order delivery status, and small product photos. No content is sent to Marracat, and logging out or deleting your account will delete it. Products added to the shopping cart or purchased together will be accompanied by this randomly installed key so that Marracat can display at least three pairs established by the installation. Restock reminders will be stored in your account: when the goods are restocked, Marracat will send an email to your account address and notify each iPhone who logs in to the account. Logout will stop the notifications on iPhone. The real-time activity for same-day delivery will send them the Apple tokens issued by Marracat, which are bound to the same installation key. Marracat will send Apple, showing the brand, product, status and carrier of each order; close them under "You" > "Notifications". Marking the order as "Delayed Shipment" will send the one-way hash value of the brand and the order, which is bound to the same key, so Marracat can see which brands have shipment delays.
